Legacy command intent:

ViewBS BisNonConvRate --sample sample.tab,WT --chrom chrC --outdir out --prefix bis --minDepth 1 --maxDepth 100

Expected output provenance:

The local legacy Perl entrypoint cannot be executed in this environment because Getopt::Long::Subcommand is not installed. This fixture follows the checked-in legacy implementation in lib/Meth/BisNonConvRate.pm:

- keep records from --chrom only;
- default context is CXX, meaning all cytosine contexts;
- keep records with 1 <= methylated + unmethylated <= 100;
- report C_number as total methylated cytosines;
- report Total_Depth as total methylated plus unmethylated depth;
- format BisNonConvRate with five decimal places.
